work.author: The translators appointed under James I of England
work.description: The English translation completed in 1611 under royal authority. Registered here for a single narrow purpose: it is the source of the English word napkin at John 20:7, and its rendering of the participle there is wrapped together, not folded. It carries no authority in the publications that cite it and is not a Catholic translation.
work.title: The Holy Bible, Authorized (King James) Version
